claim.ja: 全ての原点対称凸体で体積積≥$4^n/n!$。等号は線形Hanner体に限る。
claim.en: Every origin-symmetric body has volume product ≥$4^n/n!$, with equality exactly for linear Hanner bodies.

role.ja: 正則質量を実単体積分へ変換。等号の欠損消失から共通実行可能ベクトル、metric median、Hanner分類へ。
role.en: Convert holomorphic mass to a real simplex integral. Vanishing equality deficit gives a common feasibility witness, metric medians and Hanner classification.

claim.ja: 全ての凸体でSantaló中心の体積積≥$(n+1)^{n+1}/(n!)^2$。等号は単体に限る。
claim.en: Every convex body has Santaló-centered volume product ≥$(n+1)^{n+1}/(n!)^2$, with equality exactly for simplices.

role.ja: 正双対錐のLaplace積、Gaussian射影の同時正規化、非可換層欠損と厳密な区間評価。
role.en: Positive-dual cone Laplace integrals, simultaneous normalization of Gaussian projections, noncommutative layer defects and strict interval estimates.

claim.ja: $n\ge2$ の対称凸体と極体の積のGromov幅は4。各容量 $0<c<4$の球を埋込み、対称体積下界を導く。
claim.en: For $n\ge2$, the symmetric polar product has Gromov width 4. Balls of every capacity $0<c<4$ embed, yielding the symmetric volume bound.

role.ja: 正則零点の球と一様slice評価を合成。有限極体近似で一般の対称体へ移り、支持円柱で上界。
role.en: Combine a ball from a holomorphic zero with uniform slice control; finite polar approximation handles arbitrary symmetric bodies, while a supporting cylinder gives the upper bound.
